spans.text: She has sustained too much damage. These fragmented logs are all that we could find.
These logs alone are heartbreaking enough...
So it was definitely her performing on stage when the theater burned down, not Miss Passadou...
It was also her who was trapped in the fire. Miss Passadou wasn't even in the theater...
This was a murder.
But there's no proof...
Passadou murdered a pure and innocent soul, and the proof is lying right here.
She didn't even have a name...
I certainly didn't expect that a mad and desperate woman was all there is to this tragic legend.
The wicked supporting actress, the unfaithful husband – all fabrications to make people see her in a sympathetic light.
The forsaken Doll is leaning quietly against a stack of boxes. If she weren't covered in massive patches of black scorch marks, she could easily just have been sleeping.
Let's go. There's nothing we can do.
Can't we bring her with us back to Griffin?
She could at least keep the Commander company and sing us a song every now and then...
Neural data backups of these Type-AH400 Domestic Dolls are only kept for three months.
The server has probably long since deleted her data.
Not to mention her neural core is severely damaged...
Even if we bring her back to Griffin, we won't be able to revive her.
But I think...we could at least clean her up?
Make her look pretty again...
That's a brilliant idea, SASS!
Sure. We've already wasted enough time; doesn't hurt to stay a little longer.
The Dolls rummage through the boxes and start restoring the Doll's appearance with what they can find.
They cover up her blackened body with a simple long dress and put up her burned hair with shiny accessories. Spitfire then places a white mask on her face.
If anyone walked in on them right now, they would never have guessed that beneath the Doll's glamorous façade lies a horrifically marred body.
Time for us to go.
Yeah...
Wait, where is Miss MDR?
Probably ran off to do her stupid livestream.
Hahahahahahaha! This is huge!
Can't believe I uncovered the truth behind this cold case!
And it involves such controversial details – Doll abuse, illegal modifications, infringement of the Doll actor ban...
Pity that Passadou's popularity has been taking a nose-dive even before this came to light...
In any case, let me check in with the livestream...
Where is everybody?! Why isn't anyone watching my stream?!
Who's this? They're streaming on the same topic?!
